external_fixture.contract: Selected v2 GET /pods and GET/PUT /account/ssh-keys through proxy-a/proxy-b; bearer authentication, v2 pods/pagination envelope, keys object, full key-list replacement and problem+json errors. Self-tests cover missing/malformed/invalid authentication, forced 401/403, invalid JSON and key-list types/format/extra fields, empty account defaults and fail-closed unknown calls. The browser case checks the exact six upstream requests and preservation of a preexisting account key when the platform key is appended.

cleanup: Trace, browser context, browser, server, log copy, report write and artifact scan are guarded independently. PASS is aggregated only after business success and successful teardown/scan. Unresolved provider IDs stay scoped to the isolated private database; an unconfirmed server exit retains its PID/reclaim entry. test_provider_endpoint_cleanup.py drives the actual main through normal success and trace/context/browser/server/log/report/scan/business failures, proves later closes still run and an earlier failure never becomes PASS.

checklist_items.1.1: On first open the RunPod add dialog shows the RunPod type in its only combobox. Name is an empty required textbox with no maximum length. Its placeholder is the localized example that includes RunPod. API endpoint is a textbox whose value and placeholder are https://api.runpod.io/v2. It is not required and has no maximum length. API key is an empty password textbox, required, with no maximum length, placeholder API Key, and one visibility control. There is no spinbutton and there are three textboxes. The create POST sends kind runpod, the typed name, that endpoint, and the API key. The independent GET stores the id, kind runpod, the name, the endpoint, an empty public key, and an empty extra object, and it omits the API key.
checklist_items.1.2: On first open the RunPod dialog shows the RunPod type, an empty name, the endpoint default from the kind catalog, and an empty API key. While the saved-account GET is held, Save stays disabled and the endpoint is still empty, so the incomplete form cannot be submitted. After that GET the saved name and endpoint are backfilled and the API key stays empty.
